purpose: Discriminator: same source-built game path, stock map with 21 signals, versus Ingolstadt uncooked load hang.

observations.rpc_bind: port 2004 listening; server version answered 294096eb1-dirty; 52 maps listed
observations.terminal_state: process dead; engine log ends RenderThread crash -> RequestExit(1)
observations.crash_signature: Fatal error RenderingThread.cpp:907, inner 'Fatal error!' with empty detail, while ~19.4k shaders still compiling

failure_mechanism: render-thread fatal during uncooked first-load shader storm (~19k shaders pending). DISTINCT from Ingolstadt's game-thread traffic-light construction stall: different thread, different subsystem, different signature. Per decision tree: classify both independently; Ingolstadt failure is NOT attributed to the server path, and the server path is NOT validated by this control either.
common_factor_hypothesis: Both failures involve serving UNCOOKED content with 10-20k pending shaders. Uncooked serving is not a supported stable path on this host; the cook is required for stable runtime, not optional packaging.
not_claimed: No claim that Town10HD cannot run cooked; no claim about packaged-server behavior (packaged 0.9.16 serves Town10HD_Opt fine).
